issue: No way to exit YATDL, no About dialog
notes: Added right-click context menu on status item with About (NSAlert) and Quit. Left-click still toggles panel.
Fixed by adding local NSEvent monitor: click inside panel calls NSApp.activate + makeKey, giving text fields keyboard focus without losing .nonactivatingPanel behavior.
Same focus fix as #2. Tab creation TextField now receives input correctly.

issue: Rename: GUI stays YATDL, CLI renamed to yatdl-cli
notes: CLI binary target renamed to yatdl-cli in Makefile. One-shot help text updated. INSTALL_DIR target installs as yatdl-cli.

issue: UI/UX audit vs similar menubar apps
notes: Added right-click context menu, slide animation, full-height right-side mode, icon picker on tabs and items, delete via tab context menu.

issue: yatdl-cli: full terminal TUI mirroring desktop GUI
notes: Full-screen TUI launched with -i or --tui. Raw terminal mode, alternate screen, arrow-key navigation, tab switching (Tab/h/l), add/edit/delete items, new tabs, live file-watch sync via mtime polling every 300ms.

issue: Bootstrap iconography on tabs and items; SF Symbol/emoji picker
notes: Added icon: String field to both models. EmojiPickerView provides 32-emoji grid in a popover. Tabs: right-click → Set Icon. Items: hover → smiley button → picker.

issue: Right-side mode: full viewport height + slide-in animation
notes: Panel height uses NSScreen.main.visibleFrame.height for slide mode. ContentView uses maxHeight: .infinity. slideIn/slideOut use NSAnimationContext with easeOut/easeIn 0.25s/0.2s.
